caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a container or vessel with a cylindrical body. The central portion of the object is colored a rich, warm brown with visible vertical and diagonal wood-like grain patterns. Wrapping around both the upper and lower sections of the object is a coiled, rope-like material rendered in a tan or beige color, giving a ribbed texture. The top of the object is partially visible and has a domed, segmented lid in a darker brown shade, featuring small holes and distinct circular markings. The overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white background. The drawing is signed "Frank H. Gray" in small, neat letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Willow-Bound Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
